# Overview

This analysis is run in two parts:

1. Build a Chinese Spring-anchored 1 Mb mapping table.
2. Use that table to retrieve the corresponding interval in each pangenome.

The terminal pre-processing is included below for reproducibility but is not run when this document is rendered.

# Terminal pre-processing

Run this chunk once in Terminal. It extracts the Chinese Spring comparisons and separates the alternating Chinese Spring and pangenome rows.

```{bash}
#| eval: false

project_dir="/Users/waweru/Documents/2022/kmc_IBSpy_AP/10wheatgenomes_mummer_conversions"
input_file="$project_dir/concatenated/merged_in_windows__ws-100000_round-3_flank-50000.tsv"
paired_file="$project_dir/concatenated/chinese_merged_in_windows_ws_100000_round-3_flank_50000.tsv"
chinese_file="$project_dir/concatenated/chineseref_chinese_rows_feb082023.tsv"
pangenome_file="$project_dir/concatenated/chineseref_pangenome_rows_feb082023.tsv"

# Retain comparisons in which Chinese Spring is the assembly.
awk 'BEGIN {FS=OFS="\t"} $1 == "chinese"' "$input_file" > "$paired_file"

# Each alignment is represented by two consecutive rows.
awk 'NR % 2 == 1' "$paired_file" > "$chinese_file"
awk 'NR % 2 == 0' "$paired_file" > "$pangenome_file"

# The two output files should contain the same number of rows.
wc -l "$chinese_file" "$pangenome_file"
```

# R setup

Edit only project_dir if the analysis folder moves.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)

project_dir <- "/Users/waweru/Documents/2022/kmc_IBSpy_AP/10wheatgenomes_mummer_conversions"
data_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "concatenated")
output_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "2026-Oct_syntenicMappingOutputs")

dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

chinese_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "chineseref_chinese_rows_feb082023.tsv"
)

pangenome_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "chineseref_pangenome_rows_feb082023.tsv"
)

mapping_file <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  "01_CS_anchored_1Mb_mapping_dataset.tsv"
)

set_flextable_defaults(
  font.family = "Arial",
  font.size = 9,
  text.align = "center"
)
```

# Part 1: build the 1 Mb mapping table

The two files produced by AWK are imported and checked before they are combined. One summary row is retained for each Chinese Spring 1 Mb block and pangenome reference.

```{r}
headers_syn_dat <- c(
  "assembly",
  "reference",
  "chromosome",
  "start",
  "end",
  "block_no",
  "orientation"
)

synteny_col_types <- cols(
  assembly = col_character(),
  reference = col_character(),
  chromosome = col_character(),
  start = col_double(),
  end = col_double(),
  block_no = col_character(),
  orientation = col_character()
)

chinese <- read_tsv(
  chinese_file,
  col_names = headers_syn_dat,
  col_types = synteny_col_types,
  progress = TRUE
)

pangenome <- read_tsv(
  pangenome_file,
  col_names = headers_syn_dat,
  col_types = synteny_col_types,
  progress = TRUE
)

if (nrow(chinese) != nrow(pangenome)) {
  stop("The Chinese Spring and pangenome files have different row counts.")
}

if (
  !identical(chinese$reference, pangenome$reference) ||
  !identical(chinese$block_no, pangenome$block_no)
) {
  stop("The alternating Chinese Spring and pangenome rows are not correctly paired.")
}

# Spelta and the self-comparison are not used in the chromosome-scale panel.
excluded_references <- c("IWGSCv1.1", "spelta")

synteny_pairs <- tibble(
  reference = chinese$reference,
  chromosome = chinese$chromosome,
  block_no_chi = chinese$block_no,
  chromosome_pan = pangenome$chromosome,
  start_pan = pangenome$start,
  end_pan = pangenome$end
) %>%
  filter(!reference %in% excluded_references) %>%
  mutate(
    chrom = sub("__.*$", "", chromosome),
    block_start = as.double(
      sub(".*:([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)$", "\\1", block_no_chi)
    ),
    block_per_MB = floor(block_start / 1000000),
    block_per_chr_MB = paste0(chrom, "_", block_per_MB),
    pan_lower = pmin(start_pan, end_pan),
    pan_upper = pmax(start_pan, end_pan),
    alignment_span_bp = abs(end_pan - start_pan) + 1
  )

# Summarise each Chinese Spring 1 Mb block and retain one representative hit.
synteny_1Mb <- synteny_pairs %>%
  group_by(
    chrom,
    block_per_MB,
    block_per_chr_MB,
    reference,
    chromosome_pan
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    cs_block_start_bp = block_per_MB * 1000000 + 1,
    cs_block_end_bp = (block_per_MB + 1) * 1000000,
    pangenome_start_bp = min(pan_lower, na.rm = TRUE),
    pangenome_end_bp = max(pan_upper, na.rm = TRUE),
    representative_pan_start_bp = start_pan[
      order(alignment_span_bp, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = TRUE)
    ][1],
    representative_pan_end_bp = end_pan[
      order(alignment_span_bp, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = TRUE)
    ][1],
    alignment_count = n(),
    aligned_bp = sum(alignment_span_bp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # If a block maps to more than one chromosome, retain the strongest mapping.
  group_by(chrom, block_per_MB, reference) %>%
  slice_max(aligned_bp, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(chrom, block_per_MB) %>%
  mutate(reference_count = n_distinct(reference)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(chrom, block_per_MB, reference)

write_tsv(synteny_1Mb, mapping_file)

message(
  "Saved ", nrow(synteny_1Mb),
  " reference-by-block mappings to: ", mapping_file
)

# A short check of the generated dataset.
synteny_1Mb %>%
  distinct(chrom, block_per_MB, reference_count) %>%
  count(reference_count, name = "Number of 1 Mb blocks") %>%
  arrange(desc(reference_count)) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  autofit()
```

The saved mapping table is the input for Part 2. Part 2 can therefore be run later or in a new R session after running the setup chunk.

# Part 2: extract syntenic positions

Set the Chinese Spring target interval below. The main search uses 1 Mb blocks shared by all but at most one pangenome. A reference-specific search is used when a reference is missing from a shared boundary block or when both shared boundaries collapse to the same rounded pangenome position.

```{r}
target_chrom <- "chr2D"
target_start_bp <- 635599182
target_end_bp <- 650840934
allowed_missing_references <- 2

target_start_block <- floor(target_start_bp / 1000000)
target_end_block <- ceiling(target_end_bp / 1000000)

synteny_1Mb <- read_tsv(
  mapping_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  progress = TRUE
)

target_mapping <- synteny_1Mb %>%
  filter(chrom == target_chrom)

if (nrow(target_mapping) == 0) {
  stop("No mappings were found for ", target_chrom, ".")
}

required_columns <- c(
  "reference", "block_per_MB", "chromosome_pan",
  "representative_pan_start_bp"
)

if (!all(required_columns %in% names(target_mapping))) {
  stop("Part 1 must be rerun before running the revised Part 2.")
}

all_references <- target_mapping %>%
  distinct(reference)

minimum_shared_references <- max(
  nrow(all_references) - allowed_missing_references,
  1
)

# Identify the common Chinese Spring blocks used for the main search.
shared_blocks <- target_mapping %>%
  distinct(block_per_MB, reference) %>%
  count(block_per_MB, name = "reference_count") %>%
  filter(reference_count >= minimum_shared_references)

shared_start_block <- shared_blocks %>%
  filter(block_per_MB <= target_start_block) %>%
  slice_max(block_per_MB, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  pull(block_per_MB)

shared_end_block <- shared_blocks %>%
  filter(block_per_MB >= target_end_block) %>%
  slice_min(block_per_MB, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  pull(block_per_MB)

if (length(shared_start_block) == 0 || length(shared_end_block) == 0) {
  stop("Suitable shared start and end blocks were not found.")
}

message(
  "Shared CS anchors: ", shared_start_block, "-", shared_end_block,
  " Mb; minimum references per block: ", minimum_shared_references
)

# Extract the start and end positions from the shared blocks.
shared_start_positions <- target_mapping %>%
  filter(block_per_MB == shared_start_block) %>%
  transmute(
    reference,
    start_cs_block_mb = block_per_MB,
    start_pan_chromosome = chromosome_pan,
    start_boundary_bp = floor(
      representative_pan_start_bp / 1000000
    ) * 1000000,
    start_source = "Shared CS block"
  )

shared_start_positions

shared_end_positions <- target_mapping %>%
  filter(block_per_MB == shared_end_block) %>%
  transmute(
    reference,
    end_cs_block_mb = block_per_MB,
    end_pan_chromosome = chromosome_pan,
    end_boundary_bp = ceiling(
      representative_pan_start_bp / 1000000
    ) * 1000000,
    end_source = "Shared CS block"
  )

shared_end_positions

# Retain shared results only when they define a valid interval.
shared_position_pairs <- full_join(
  shared_start_positions,
  shared_end_positions,
  by = "reference"
)

valid_shared_pairs <- shared_position_pairs %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(start_boundary_bp),
    !is.na(end_boundary_bp),
    start_pan_chromosome == end_pan_chromosome,
    start_boundary_bp != end_boundary_bp
  )

valid_shared_pairs

# Missing, conflicting or collapsed results are searched independently.
fallback_references <- all_references %>%
  anti_join(valid_shared_pairs, by = "reference")

if (nrow(fallback_references) > 0) {
  message(
    "Independent fallback search: ",
    paste(fallback_references$reference, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

fallback_start_candidates <- target_mapping %>%
  semi_join(fallback_references, by = "reference") %>%
  filter(block_per_MB <= target_start_block) %>%
  transmute(
    reference,
    start_cs_block_mb = block_per_MB,
    start_pan_chromosome = chromosome_pan,
    start_boundary_bp = floor(
      representative_pan_start_bp / 1000000
    ) * 1000000,
    start_distance = target_start_block - block_per_MB
  )

fallback_end_candidates <- target_mapping %>%
  semi_join(fallback_references, by = "reference") %>%
  filter(block_per_MB >= target_end_block) %>%
  transmute(
    reference,
    end_cs_block_mb = block_per_MB,
    end_pan_chromosome = chromosome_pan,
    end_boundary_bp = ceiling(
      representative_pan_start_bp / 1000000
    ) * 1000000,
    end_distance = block_per_MB - target_end_block
  )

# Choose the closest pair that maps to one chromosome and has two boundaries.
fallback_pairs <- inner_join(
  fallback_start_candidates,
  fallback_end_candidates,
  by = "reference"
) %>%
  filter(
    start_pan_chromosome == end_pan_chromosome,
    start_boundary_bp != end_boundary_bp
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    anchor_distance = start_distance + end_distance,
    interval_width_bp = abs(end_boundary_bp - start_boundary_bp)
  ) %>%
  group_by(reference) %>%
  slice_min(anchor_distance, n = 1, with_ties = TRUE) %>%
  slice_min(interval_width_bp, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    reference,
    start_cs_block_mb,
    start_pan_chromosome,
    start_boundary_bp,
    start_source = "Reference-specific fallback",
    end_cs_block_mb,
    end_pan_chromosome,
    end_boundary_bp,
    end_source = "Reference-specific fallback"
  )

selected_position_pairs <- bind_rows(
  valid_shared_pairs,
  fallback_pairs
)

selected_position_pairs

# Combine the selected positions into one interval per reference.
syntenic_positions <- all_references %>%
  left_join(selected_position_pairs, by = "reference") %>%
  mutate(
    chromosome_match = (
      !is.na(start_pan_chromosome) &
      !is.na(end_pan_chromosome) &
      start_pan_chromosome == end_pan_chromosome
    ),
    pangenome_chromosome = case_when(
      chromosome_match ~ sub("__.*$", "", start_pan_chromosome),
      is.na(start_pan_chromosome) ~ sub("__.*$", "", end_pan_chromosome),
      is.na(end_pan_chromosome) ~ sub("__.*$", "", start_pan_chromosome),
      TRUE ~ paste(
        sub("__.*$", "", start_pan_chromosome),
        sub("__.*$", "", end_pan_chromosome),
        sep = " / "
      )
    ),
    syntenic_start_bp = if_else(
      chromosome_match,
      pmin(start_boundary_bp, end_boundary_bp),
      NA_real_
    ),
    syntenic_end_bp = if_else(
      chromosome_match,
      pmax(start_boundary_bp, end_boundary_bp),
      NA_real_
    ),
    interval_size_bp = syntenic_end_bp - syntenic_start_bp + 1,
    Notes = case_when(
      is.na(start_cs_block_mb) | is.na(end_cs_block_mb) ~
        "No valid start-end pair was recovered",
      !chromosome_match ~
        "Start and end anchors mapped to different chromosomes",
      start_source == "Reference-specific fallback" |
        end_source == "Reference-specific fallback" ~
        paste0(
          "Reference-specific fallback; CS anchors: ",
          start_cs_block_mb, "-", end_cs_block_mb, " Mb"
        ),
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    Genome = recode(
      reference,
      arinalrfor = "ArinaLrFor",
      jagger = "Jagger",
      julius = "Julius",
      lancer = "Lancer",
      landmark = "Landmark",
      mace = "Mace",
      norin61 = "Norin 61",
      stanley = "Stanley",
      sy_mattis = "SY Mattis",
      .default = str_to_title(str_replace_all(reference, "_", " "))
    )
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    Genome,
    Chromosome = pangenome_chromosome,
    syntenic_start_bp,
    syntenic_end_bp,
    interval_size_bp,
    Notes
  )

# Add the original Chinese Spring interval to the combined table.
chinese_spring_position <- tibble(
  Genome = "Chinese Spring",
  Chromosome = target_chrom,
  syntenic_start_bp = target_start_bp,
  syntenic_end_bp = target_end_bp,
  interval_size_bp = target_end_bp - target_start_bp + 1,
  Notes = ""
)

final_table <- bind_rows(
  chinese_spring_position,
  syntenic_positions
) %>%
  arrange(desc(Genome == "Chinese Spring"), Genome) %>%
  rename(
    "Syntenic start (bp)" = syntenic_start_bp,
    "Syntenic end (bp)" = syntenic_end_bp,
    "Interval size (bp)" = interval_size_bp
  )

# Remove the Notes column when no warnings are present.
if (all(final_table$Notes == "")) {
  final_table <- select(final_table, -Notes)
}

final_tsv <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  "02_chr2D_635599182-650840934_syntenic_positions.tsv"
)

final_docx <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  "02_chr2D_635599182-650840934_syntenic_positions.docx"
)

write_tsv(final_table, final_tsv, na = "")

table_caption <- paste0(
  "Syntenic positions corresponding to the Chinese Spring RefSeq v1.0 ",
  target_chrom, " interval ",
  scales::comma(target_start_bp), "-", scales::comma(target_end_bp),
  " across wheat pangenome assemblies."
)

thesis_table <- final_table %>%
  flextable() %>%
  set_caption(caption = table_caption) %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  colformat_num(
    j = c(
      "Syntenic start (bp)",
      "Syntenic end (bp)",
      "Interval size (bp)"
    ),
    big.mark = ",",
    digits = 0,
    na_str = ""
  ) %>%
  align(j = "Genome", align = "left", part = "all") %>%
  autofit() %>%
  set_table_properties(layout = "autofit")

save_as_docx(
  values = list("Syntenic positions" = thesis_table),
  path = final_docx
)

message("Saved the final table to: ", final_tsv)
message("Saved the Word table to: ", final_docx)

thesis_table
```
